title: Image - Data API
description: Represents the details of an image. This object is available in API version 47.0 and later.

AlternateText.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
AlternateText.description: Accessibility text to explain the image in words.

CapturedAngle.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
CapturedAngle.description: Angle at which the image was captured.

ContentDocumentId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ContentDocumentId.description: Unique identifier of the content document where image is stored. This is a relationship field.

ImageClass.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
ImageClass.description: The image category. Possible values are: FOOD LOGOS OBJECTS SCENES

ImageClassObjectType.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
ImageClassObjectType.description: The type of image. Used in Einstein Object Detection to identify whether the image is used to detect objects or build a model. Possible values are: DETECTION—Actual Image FEEDBACK TRAINING

ImageViewType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

IsActive.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsActive.description: Indicates if an image is active. The default value is False. An active image can be used for building or updating a model in Einstein Object Detection.

LastReferencedDate.description: The date on which the image was last referenced.

LastViewedDate.description: The date on which the image was last viewed.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Nillable, Sort, Update

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: Unique identifier of the record owner. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

Title.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

Url.description: Public URL of the image file.
